title: Asking about a job advert
instructions: Bir öğrenci kafedeki iş ilanını soruyor. Saatler, ücret ve başlama tarihine dikkat et.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Hi. I saw your advert for a part-time job. Is it still available?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes, it is. Have you worked in a café before?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Yes, for six months last summer.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Good. We need someone on Saturdays and Sundays, from nine to three.

script.speaker: a
script.text: That's perfect. I have classes during the week. What's the pay?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Eleven pounds an hour, and you can have free lunch.
